title: Chapter 355 - 355 Surprised; Bragging!

Chapter 355 - 355 Surprised; Bragging!

Chapter 355 - 355 Surprised; Bragging!

355 Surprised; Bragging!

Rumble!

As the luxury plane trembled, it suddenly shot up into the sky.

After a while, they passed through layers of clouds and arrived in the blue sky.

After the plane stabilized, a beautiful air stewardess pushed a small dining table and walked over with a smile on her face.

“What’s there to eat?” the oval-faced woman asked.

“Australian lobster, bread crab, top-grade Wagyu beef, natural vegetables, top-grade abalone…” the beautiful air stewardess said.

The oval-faced woman was a little stunned when she heard the names of the dishes.

After a while, the oval-faced woman said, “Then… Then I’ll have a serving of lobster and beef…”

She did not dare to say that it was Australian lobster or top-grade Wagyu beef.

It was because she felt that she might have been hearing things.

If she mentioned Australian lobster and top-grade Wagyu, she might end up making a joke of herself.

“Alright,” the beautiful air stewardess said with a smile.

As she spoke, she placed the Australian lobster that reached the length of one’s elbow and the top-grade Wagyu beef that was as white as snowflakes in front of the oval-faced woman.

Seeing this…

The oval-faced woman was completely stunned.

It was true!

This was really Australian lobster and top-grade Wagyu beef!

She did not hear wrongly just now!

However, what was going on?

At this moment, the beautiful air stewardess asked again, “Do you need anything to drink?

“We have 2003 Lafite, Flying Maotai, Louis 13, Hennessy, natural fruit juice, high-end coffee, high-protein milk, high-end yogurt, and so on.”

The oval-faced woman said, “I… I want red wine.”

“Alright,” said the beautiful air stewardess.

Then, she handed it to the oval-faced woman.

Lafite!

It really was Lafite!

The oval-faced woman was stunned again.

In fact…

She was not the only one who was stunned. The other employees of Flower Stem who were also on the plane were stunned too.

They could be said to be the middle and upper management of the company. Perhaps some of them had never been abroad.

However, they had all taken a plane before!

Usually, there would be some food prepared on the plane.

However, most only served items like bread, beef brisket, shredded potatoes, and other very cheap food.

Now, the food in front of them… Not to mention the food, just this glass of 2003 Lafite would probably cost hundreds or thousands of yuan, right?

This meal would probably be more expensive than the plane ticket, right?

Was the airline company earning that much money?

At this moment, someone suddenly said, “It seems that there are only us on the plane. There are no other passengers.”

When everyone heard this, they looked around and realized that there was really no one else. They could not help but look at each other.

Lin Fan turned around and asked, “What are you guys doing? Eat up.”

The oval-faced woman opened her mouth. She could not help but voice the doubts in her heart.

“M-Mr. Lin, did you book this plane?”

“No, I didn’t,” Lin Fan replied.

Everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

Lin Fan continued, “I’m a major shareholder of Xia Airlines. I don’t need to book chartered flights.”

Silence.

The entire plane was silent.

The oval-faced woman, the employees of Flower Stem, and even Chu Yunyue were stunned.

One had to know that Xia Airlines was the largest private airline company in Hua Nation!

Lin Fan… was actually a major shareholder?

No wonder those beautiful stewardesses were so respectful to Lin Fan and served him so well…

If that was the case, everything made sense.

“When did you invest in Xia Airlines?” asked Chu Yunyue.”

Lin Fan said, “It’s been a while.”

He did not explain much about when and how much money he had spent.

This was because he had received everything from the system’s red packets. It was not easy to explain.

…

Another plane was heading toward Eagle Country. It was not as luxurious as Lin Fan’s plane.

The plane was full of people. The air was filled with the stench of body odor, foot odor, and other unpleasant smells.

For lunch, they had fries, burgers, tomato beef brisket rice, and other cheap food.

A round-faced Caucasian man named Jonah Roger swallowed the last bite of his burger and wiped the oil off his face. He praised, “We’re finally reaching Eagle Country!”

Beside him, Li Li, who was wearing heavy makeup, had a look of excitement on her face.

Jonah Roger’s eyes turned slightly, and he said, “Li Li, the streets of Hua Nation are filled with rubbish and all kinds of dirty things. When you get off the plane, you’ll understand what it means to be an international metropolis. The streets are spotless, and the buildings are extremely beautiful…

“Didn’t you want to stay in Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel? It just so happens that my family used to do business with Royal Hotel. My father is also good friends with the owner of the Royal Hotel!

“I’ve already told my dad about our arrival. He’ll arrange for people from Royal Hotel to come and pick us up.”

When Jonah Roger said this, he could not help but raise his neck, looking like a high and mighty yet mysterious young master.

In reality?

He lied about his family having done business with Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel.

He also lied about his father and the owner of the Royal Hotel being good friends.

He did not have a prominent family background, and his father was only familiar with an ordinary manager of the Royal Hotel.

Jonah Roger had indeed told his father about their arrival… He also said that they were going to stay at the Royal Hotel.

In this way, he could get a little discount from that supervisor.

As for picking them up… That was normal because the Royal Hotel had a pick-up service.

Jonah Roger secretly glanced at Li Li’s exquisite figure.

He believed that after saying all this, Li Li would definitely worship him. When he brought her to the Royal Hotel, he would definitely be able to get her.

It had to be said that Jonah Roger had a good grasp of Li Li’s psychology.

Li Li was very interested in foreigners.

At this moment, she heard from Jonah that his family was able to do business with the Royal Hotel.

Jonah Roger’s father was a good friend of the owner of the Royal Hotel!

In Li Li’s heart, she was already imagining Jonah Roger’s huge family power…

Gradually, Jonah seemed to occupy more of her heart, causing her to be in a daze. Her face, which was covered in foundation, also began to reveal a hint of redness.

Perhaps she would have a chance to join a foreign wealthy family!

Rumble!

At this moment, the passenger plane shook violently.

At the same time, a brisk voice sounded from the plane’s broadcast.

“Dear passengers, there’s strong turbulence ahead. Please don’t panic and fasten your seatbelts…”

The plane shook for about five minutes before it finally calmed down.

After the plane continued on for two hours, an announcement sounded again.

“Dear passengers, the plane is about to land in Lun City, Eagle Country. It’s now 2:10 pm in Lun City, and the temperature is 23 degrees… Please remain seated and fasten your seatbelts. The plane is about to land.”
